exams.name: Qualifying examination (property broker-agent, casualty broker-agent, life agent, accident and health or sickness agent, personal lines broker-agent, limited lines automobile insurance agent)
exams.notes: Must be taken and passed within 12 months preceding license issuance. Offered in English, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Vietnamese, Korean, and (on/after July 1, 2024) Tagalog.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by or through the California Department of Insurance)
exams.quote: A person shall not be admitted to more than 10 license qualification examinations of the same type in any 12-month period.

interval_years.quote: "License term" for a personal lines license means all of that two-year period beginning as described in either subdivision (a) or (b) of Section 1629, as applicable, and ending the second succeeding year on the last calendar day of the month in which the initial license was issued.

required.quote: A licensee, as specified in this section, shall satisfactorily complete 24 hours of instruction, of which three hours shall be in ethics, prior to renewal of the license.

hours_per_period.quote: A licensee, as specified in this section, shall satisfactorily complete 24 hours of instruction, of which three hours shall be in ethics, prior to renewal of the license.

period_years.quote: "License term" for a personal lines license means all of that two-year period beginning as described in either subdivision (a) or (b) of Section 1629, as applicable, and ending the second succeeding year on the last calendar day of the month in which the initial license was issued.

value: 3 hours ethics (including 1 hour insurance fraud on/after March 1, 2023)
annuity training: 8 hours initial + 4 hours per renewal for life agents selling annuities
life insurance training: 4 hours initial for life agents selling non-term life (on/after Jan 1, 2025); 2 hours per renewal for variable life
topical_requirements.quote: On and after March 1, 2023, the three-hour ethics course shall include one hour of study on insurance fraud.

available.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to Article 6 (commencing with Section 1666), a nonresident person shall receive a production agency license if that nonresident person meets the following requirements

requirements.value: Nonresident must be currently licensed and in good standing in their home state/territory/province, submit proper application and fees, submit NAIC Uniform Nonresident Application or home-state application, and home state must award nonresident licenses to California residents on the same basis (reciprocity).
requirements.quote: The person is currently licensed and in good standing in the state, territory of the United States, or province of Canada in which the person is licensed as a resident producer.

credential_type.quote: A license is a permit to act in the capacity specified therein.

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who transacts insurance without a valid license so to act is guilty of a misdemeanor punishable by a fine not exceeding fifty thousand dollars ($50,000) or by imprisonment in a county jail for a period not exceeding one year, or by both that fine and imprisonment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant is not properly qualified to perform the duties of the license sought.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant is not properly qualified to perform the duties of a person holding the license for which the applicant applied.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Granting the license would be against public interest.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The granting of the license will be against public interest.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant does not intend actively and in good faith to carry on the licensed business with the general public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant does not intend actively and in good faith to carry on as a business with the general public the transactions that would be permitted by the issuance of the license for which the applicant applied.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant is not of good business reputation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant is not of good business reputation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant is lacking in integrity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant is lacking in integrity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant has had a professional license refused, suspended, or revoked for reasons that should preclude granting the current license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has been refused a professional, occupational, or vocational license or had a professional, occupational, or vocational license suspended or revoked by a licensing authority for reasons that should preclude the granting of the license for which the applicant applied.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant seeks the license for the purpose of avoiding or preventing enforcement of insurance laws.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant seeks the license for the purpose of avoiding or preventing the operation or enforcement of the insurance laws of this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant knowingly or willfully made a misstatement in an application or supporting document.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has knowingly or willfully made a misstatement in an application to the commissioner for a license, or in a document filed in support of that application, or has made a false statement in testimony given under oath before the commissioner or another person acting in the commissioner's stead.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant has previously engaged in a fraudulent practice or conducted business dishonestly.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has previously engaged in a fraudulent practice or act or has conducted any business in a dishonest manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant has shown incompetency or untrustworthiness in the conduct of any business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has shown incompetency or untrustworthiness in the conduct of any business, or has by commission of a wrongful act or practice in the course of any business exposed the public or those dealing with the applicant to the danger of loss.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant has knowingly misrepresented the terms or effect of an insurance policy or contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has knowingly misrepresented the terms or effect of an insurance policy or contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant has failed to perform a duty enjoined by the Insurance Code or committed an act expressly forbidden by it.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has failed to perform a duty expressly enjoined upon them by this code or has committed an act expressly forbidden by this code.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant has been convicted of a felony, a misdemeanor specified by insurance laws, or a public offense involving fraud or dishonesty.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has been convicted of any of the following: (1) A felony. (2) A misdemeanor specified by this code or other laws regulating insurance. (3) A public offense having as one of its necessary elements a fraudulent act or an act of dishonesty in acceptance, custody, or payment of money or property.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant has aided or abetted a person in an act that would constitute grounds for suspension, revocation, or refusal of a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has aided or abetted a person in an act or omission that would constitute grounds for the suspension, revocation, or refusal of a license or certificate issued under this code to the person aided or abetted.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant has permitted a person in their employ to violate the Insurance Code.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has permitted a person in the applicant's employ to violate this code.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant has violated a law relating to conduct of business that could lawfully be done only under authority of the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has violated a law relating to conduct of business that could lawfully be done only under authority conferred by that license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant has submitted a false or fraudulent certificate of coverage to the commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has submitted to the commissioner a false or fraudulent certificate pursuant to subdivision (d) of Section 1749.5.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant has been found liable by clear and convincing evidence in a civil action involving elder/dependent abuse, fraud, misappropriation, misrepresentation, or breach of fiduciary duty.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has been found liable by clear and convincing evidence in a civil action involving allegations of elder or dependent abuse, oppression, fraud, malice, misappropriation or conversion of funds, misrepresentation, or breach of fiduciary duty.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has induced a client to make a loan, investment, gift, or provide future benefit to the licensee or related persons.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has induced a client, whether directly or indirectly, to cosign or make a loan, make an investment, make a gift, including a testamentary gift, or provide any future benefit through a right of survivorship to the licensee, or to any of the persons listed in subdivision (e).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has induced a client to make the licensee a beneficiary under a trust or insurance policy.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has induced a client, whether directly or indirectly, to make the licensee or any of the persons listed in subdivision (e) a beneficiary under the terms of any intervivos or testamentary trust or the owner or beneficiary of a life insurance policy or an annuity policy.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee or applicant fails to promptly reply in writing to an inquiry from the commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commissioner may revoke, suspend, or refuse to issue or renew a license if the licensee or applicant does not promptly reply in writing to an inquiry from the commissioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee fails to keep or maintain required records.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of the licensee to comply with the order within the time specified therein shall be grounds for the suspension or revocation of the license or licenses of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subject person has engaged in misconduct causing financial or other injury, or fraud/dishonesty, demonstrating unfitness to continue.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The subject person has engaged in misconduct with respect to the business of insurance that has caused financial or other injury to any person

bonding_required.quote: A property broker-agent, a casualty broker-agent, and a personal lines broker-agent shall, prior to acting in the capacity of an insurance broker, file with the commissioner and continuously maintain in force the bond required by this article.

insurance_required.quote: Maintain a policy or policies of insurance against liability imposed on or against it by law for damages arising out of claims in an amount for each claim of at least one hundred thousand dollars ($100,000) multiplied by the number of licensees rendering professional services on behalf of the company

definition_quote.value: An insurance agent is a person who transacts insurance, other than life, disability, or health insurance, on behalf of an admitted insurance company.
definition_quote.quote: An insurance agent is a person who transacts insurance, other than life, disability, or health insurance, on behalf of an admitted insurance company.

nonresident_license_available.quote: A nonresident license is a license issued to a person not a resident of this state.

The 12-hour ethics course shall include one hour of study on insurance fraud.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: Every applicant for an organizational license shall provide the names of all licensed natural persons who may exercise the power and perform the duties under the license.

temporary_license_available.quote: The commissioner may issue to an eligible person a certificate of convenience to act as any of the following: (a) Any type of a licensee under this chapter ... to administer the business of a licensed person who has died or who has been declared incompetent

temporary_license_max_days.quote: Upon the expiration of one year after the death of the deceased property broker-agent, casualty broker-agent, or life agent

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: Any person acting as a licensee under this chapter shall not act as an agent of an insurer unless the insurer has filed with the commissioner a notice of appointment, executed by the insurer, appointing the licensee as the insurer's agent.

written_consumer_representation_agreemen.quote: It shall be presumed that the person is acting as an insurance broker if the person is licensed to act as an insurance broker, maintains the bond required by this chapter, and discloses, in a written agreement signed by the consumer, all of the following

fiduciary_duty_for_funds.quote: All funds received by any person acting as a licensee under this chapter ... as premium or return premium on or under any policy of insurance or undertaking of bail, are received and held by that person in that person's fiduciary capacity.

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: Notification to the commissioner shall be in writing and shall be sent within 30 days of the date the applicant or licensee learns of the change in background information.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The Insurance Commissioner may also verify the producer's licensing status through the Producer Database maintained by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners, its affiliates or subsidiaries.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: A nonresident producer who moves from one state to another state or a resident producer who moves from this state to another state shall file a change of address and provide certification from the new resident state within 30 days of the change of legal residence.

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: The application for renewal of an expired license may be filed after the expiration date and until that same month and day of the next succeeding year.

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: The commissioner shall submit to the Department of Justice fingerprint images and related information required by the Department of Justice pursuant to subdivision (u) of Section 11105 of the Penal Code
